label: GO step, first ~50 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never D1/D2), and only in roughly the first 50 trials of an episode: rate is ~0.33 at trials 1-2, ~0.17 through trial 39, then falls to ~0 after trial ~65. So it looks like an episode-time / slow hidden-state drift signal, not a task variable. Within early GO steps it fires about half the time, and no task variable (reward, transition, stay, good state, choice) splits it cleanly. Using model_act==2 or a confident policy logit trades recall for precision with no F1 gain. It is correlated with the value head being in a mid band (7.7-8.1), which is likely the same time-in-episode effect. Magnitude, checked: larger earlier in the episode (trials <30 hold 78% of the mass but 59% of the activations), and larger after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward==0 has 37% of early-GO activations but 50% of the mass). The top activations are GO steps after r0. It is somewhat more frequent on a2 choices. It does not fire at D1 or D2, or late in the episode (after trial ~70). The predicate uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u, a1 S2 r) and this trial (GO: a2 S2, a2 S1, fix); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=0, phase=GO & ep_dec=1, phase=GO & ep_dec=2.
